intent: Individually teach school-purpose article use,class group/lesson,classroom compound,each student present/past,pupil school/eye senses without age absolutes,teacher noun versus teach,explicit headteacher/principal comparison and lesson number. Eight strict form lists,original sentences,changed school/class rewrites and fresh named-role/time/classroom-label reading remain draft.
picturePurpose: Planned original school exterior/classroom interior image supports classroom identification. Roles,student counts and timetable come from written records,never inferred from faces or generated text.

workshop.title: 分清学校、课堂和人物，再安排参观
workshop.instruction: 先看场景、读句子判断，再补词、写自己的例子。最后按新记录安排参观，不凭身份猜任务。

items.label: school：上学和去某所学校，留意目的
items.prompt: 记录：Mia每天作为学生去上学。哪句符合这个意思？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：Mia每天作为学生去上学。哪句符合这个意思？

items.material: Our school opens its gates at seven.
items.reason: school可指学校这一机构。go to school常说作为学生去上学；go to the school可强调去某所学校，例如去那里取资料。不是看到school就一律删the。
items.hint: go to school：去上学；go to the school：去某所学校。

options.text: Mia goes to school every weekday.
options.reason: 这里强调作为学生去上学，通常说go to school。

options.text: Mia goes school every weekday.
options.reason: go后不能直接接school来表达这个意思，需要to。

options.text: Mia stays at home every weekday.
options.reason: 留在家里改变了每天去上学的信息。

items.label: class：一节课还是全班，放回语境
items.prompt: 记录：Our class is making a poster together. 这句class指什么？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：Our class is making a poster together. 这句class指什么？

items.material: We have an art class after lunch.
items.reason: class可以指班级，也能指一节课。have an art class是上美术课；our class is making...说全班在做事。classroom是教室，不能只按中文“班”猜。
items.hint: an art class：美术课；our class：我们班。

options.text: The room where the poster is stored.
options.reason: classroom才是教室；本句making的执行者是全班同学。

options.text: Only one art lesson after lunch.
options.reason: 那是前面例句的用法；这句说全班一起制作海报，不能照搬旧语境。

options.text: The group of students working together.
options.reason: our class一起制作海报，这里指班级里的同学。

items.label: classroom：教室，合成词写成一个词
items.prompt: 找classroom：这题要找有课桌和黑板的室内教室。点场景或选描述。

wordDecision.prompt: 找classroom：这题要找有课桌和黑板的室内教室。点场景或选描述。

art.alt: 蓝线分开的两个原创场景：左边是有校门和教学楼的校园外景；右边是有课桌和空白黑板的室内教室。部分近处桌椅超出右图边缘；不据图数课桌、推算班级人数或猜测年级。参观记录中的人名、身份、时间另由文字给出。

evidence.caption: 教室已选中。对照校园外景与室内教室，再核对。
校园已选中。对照校园外景与室内教室，再核对。

items.material: The classroom looks brighter with new curtains.
items.reason: classroom由class和room组成，写成一个词。右边室内场景是教室，左边是校园外景。school可以指整所学校，classroom是其中的一间教室。

options.text: The indoor room with desks and a board.
options.reason: 教室是室内的学习空间；classroom是一个词。

options.text: The outside view of the school grounds.
options.reason: 这是校园外景；本题要找室内的教室。

items.label: student：each后先用单数
items.prompt: 记录：每名学生各选一个主题。哪句数量和动词都合适？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：每名学生各选一个主题。哪句数量和动词都合适？

items.material: Each student chose a different topic.
items.reason: student可指中学生、大学生等。each student强调每一名学生；student用单数，若是一般现在时，动词也要配合。原例句chose是过去式，不要机械改成chooses。
items.hint: each student chooses；昨天可说each student chose。

options.text: Each students chooses a topic.
options.reason: each后不能直接用复数students。

options.text: Each student chooses a topic.
options.reason: each后接单数student；一般现在时中主语是each student，动词用chooses。

options.text: Each student choose a topic.
options.reason: 主语each student是单数，动词应写chooses。

items.label: pupil：学校里的学生，别用年龄一刀切
items.prompt: 记录：The youngest pupil read the first line. 哪项符合这里pupil的意思？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：The youngest pupil read the first line. 哪项符合这里pupil的意思？

items.material: The youngest pupil read the first line.
items.reason: pupil在学校语境中是学生，常用于小学阶段，但不能说只允许指小学生。pupil也有瞳孔的意思；youngest pupil read...说的是学生在读。
items.hint: 看动作和上下文：pupil在这里指学生。

options.text: The person teaching the lesson.
options.reason: 本句说pupil读第一行，并没有把这个人说成老师。

options.text: A learner at a school.
options.reason: pupil在这里是学校里的学生，常用于小学学生，也可用于其他学校阶段。

options.text: The dark opening in the centre of an eye.
options.reason: pupil还有瞳孔这一义项，但这里有youngest和read，是学生的语境。

items.label: teacher：教的人，名词与动作分开
items.prompt: 句子Our ___ asked us to test the idea. 空格要填“老师”，哪项符合？

wordDecision.prompt: 句子Our ___ asked us to test the idea. 空格要填“老师”，哪项符合？

items.material: Our teacher asked us to test the idea.
items.after: asked us to test the idea.
items.reason: teach是教；teacher是教师。Our teacher asked...中teacher作名词，asked才是过去发生的动作。不要看到“教”就只填teach。

options.text: teach
options.reason: teach是动词原形，不能直接放在our后充当这里的“老师”。

options.text: teacher
options.reason: our后这里需要表示人的名词teacher。

options.text: teaches
options.reason: teaches是动词形式；这里不是给teach加第三人称单数。

items.label: headteacher：英美称呼在比较句中保留
items.prompt: 记录：In British English, the school head is often called the headteacher. 美式常用哪个对应称呼？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：In British English, the school head is often called the headteacher. 美式常用哪个对应称呼？

items.material: The headteacher welcomed our visitors at the gate.
items.after: welcomed our visitors at the gate.
items.reason: 英式常用headteacher，美式常用principal。principal与principle不是同一个词：前者可指校长，后者是原则。这里是比较称呼，不是把所有teacher都替换成principal。

options.text: principle
options.reason: principle是原则，和principal只差一个字母，但不是校长。

options.text: principal
options.reason: 英式headteacher常对应美式principal，指学校负责人。

options.text: pupil
options.reason: pupil是学生，不是这里学校负责人的称呼。

items.label: lesson：数一节课，two后用复数
items.prompt: 记录：今天有两节英语课。哪句符合数量？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：今天有两节英语课。哪句符合数量？

items.material: Today's lesson begins with a short puzzle.
items.reason: lesson是一节课。one lesson、two lessons要配合数量。class在某些语境也能说一节课；本题比较的是lesson与classroom，不把两个近义词硬判成对错。
items.hint: two lessons：两节课；two classrooms：两间教室。

options.text: We have two English lesson today.
options.reason: 数量是two，lesson不能仍用单数。

options.text: We have two English classrooms today.
options.reason: classroom是教室，把两节课变成了两个房间。

options.text: We have two English lessons today.
options.reason: two后用复数lessons，表示两节英语课。

transfer.stem: Which plan follows this new school visit note?
transfer.passage:
SCHOOL VISIT NOTE
Ms Lin, the headteacher, will welcome visitors at the gate at 8:40. Mr Chen, a teacher, will lead them to Classroom 6 at 8:50. His class has twenty-eight pupils. The first lesson begins at 9:00. Visitors can watch from the back, but they should not talk during the lesson. Student guides will take visitors to the office afterwards.

options.text: Meet Ms Lin at the gate at 8:40, then follow Mr Chen to Classroom 6 at 8:50.
Meet Mr Chen at the gate at 8:40, then follow Ms Lin to Classroom 6.
Talk with the pupils from the back while the lesson is in progress.
Visit six classrooms before 9:00 because the note says Classroom 6.

answer.display: Meet Ms Lin at the gate at 8:40, then follow Mr Chen to Classroom 6 at 8:50.

explanation.strategy: 把人名、职责、地点和时间配对；地点编号不能当作数量。

steps.text: 8:40在校门口迎接的是校长Ms Lin。
steps.reason: Ms Lin后面的the headteacher解释她的身份；welcome、gate和8:40属于同一安排。

steps.text: 8:50由老师Mr Chen带到6号教室，9:00才开始上课。
steps.reason: 第二句把Mr Chen、lead、Classroom 6和8:50配在一起。6是教室编号，不是要参观六间教室。

distractors.reason: 把两个人在这份安排中的任务对调了；并非说校长永远不能带路，而是本次记录另有分工。
should not talk during the lesson明确要求上课时不要交谈。
Classroom 6指6号教室；记录没有安排参观六间教室。

explanation.pitfall: 身份词帮助认人，动词决定本次任务；别交换人名或把编号当数量。

visual.title: 按本次安排认人、到位
visual.caption: 人名、时间和职责来自文字；不靠图片中的年龄、服装猜身份。

explanation.transfer: 如果欢迎来宾的人改为Mr Chen，哪条配对需要更新？不能只因他不是校长就否认新安排。
